text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with 
Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm, well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...L-Look, the river's so full of water. 
A-And, so... that's right—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Speaking of water... Aren't you thirsty?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is that so... W-What should I do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something is clearly wrong with Silence 
Suzuka...!
choice_data_list:
C-Come to think of it, I might be a little 
thirsty...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: R-Really!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I have some mineral water with me. If 
you'd like some, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... I just finished drinking it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... Um, what should I do—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-I'll go buy some, okay...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly stopped Silence Suzuka, who 
was about to dash off to buy water.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. For losing my composure 
like that."
choice_data_list:
You've been acting a little strange for a 
while now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I thought it might make you happy, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I wanted to thank you... for 
everything you usually do...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A token of everyday appreciation. In that 
case—
choice_data_list:
I'd love it if you could run freely and 
comfortably.

I'd appreciate it if you're careful not to 
overdo it with your running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Free and easy... you say?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see, I understand. If that will make 
them happy—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go for a run right away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I could stop her this time, 
Silence Suzuka had already run off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking alone for a while after 
that, Silence Suzuka returned.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen to this. The sunset view 
from the riverbank was so beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't seem... much different from 
usual...
choice_data_list:
I didn't mean you should run right this 
second, though...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? I'm so sorry, I completely 
assumed...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll take some time to think about a way 
to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So, um... that view just now was truly 
beautiful—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I ran back ahead 
of you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Silence Suzuka's back as she ran 
off, she looked as carefree and 
unconstrained as she had hoped to be.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: T-That's... umm...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. I will do my best to address 
it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
............ Don't over-run, don't 
over-run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
............Huh? H-How many hours counts 
as... running too much...?
choice_data_list:
You don't have to push yourself so 
hard...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness... I'm sorry, it seems 
that was too difficult for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to run plenty without 
overdoing it. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then let's take this riverbank right away—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What happened to talking about the 
reward...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the reward from Silence Suzuka was 
put on hold for the time being.
